contract_checks: Panel Plugin.runPluginMigrations (plugin database/migrations auto-run on install)

semantics_used: memory_limit and disk space build limits are MiB (environment/settings.go comments, configuration.go DiskSpace() x1024x1024)
zero stored limit = unlimited (internal/ufs/fs_quota.go CanFit: limit 0 always fits; power.go DiskSpace() <= 0 skips check)

panel_runtime.queue: redis (verified production: QUEUE_CONNECTION=redis, pelican-queue.service runs php artisan queue:work --tries=3)
panel_runtime.cache_locks: cache store must support locks (file/redis/database all do)

verified_source_facts: EggChangerService::handle(Server, Egg|int, keepOldVariables=true): same-egg early return; forceFill egg_id/image=first docker_images/startup=first startup_commands; recreates ServerVariables carrying old values by env_variable
ReinstallServerService::handle: transaction sets ServerState::Installing then DaemonServerRepository::reinstall()

ServerInstallController::store: node-gated callback records InstallFailed/ReinstallFailed or clears status, keeps Suspended, sets installed_at, dispatches App.Events.Server.Installed; NO plugin operation token - completion correlation is status-poll based by design
Server.model: memory/disk unsigned integer MiB columns; isInstalled/isFailedInstall/isInConflictState helpers used by the switch precheck
Plugin manifest: id must equal top-level folder name; Plugin::getProviders() auto-scans src/Providers; PluginService registers panel classes via Filament Panel->plugin() for ids in manifest 'panels'
